title: W08c: native Monitor views and refresh behavior
description: Build the native desktop Monitor as a read-only surface over the plugin backend: a project selector with explicit selected-project identity; tasks grouped by all seven statuses with priority, readiness and dependency blockers; task detail with description, acceptance, claims, evidence sources and messages plus lifecycle history; an active claim view with actor, branch and worktree; issue list and detail; handoff list and detail with unfinished work, tests, risks and next steps; agent discussion threads over the canonical Waystation messages with sender, recipient or broadcast, kind, timestamp, thread, reply link and associated task or issue; and last successful observation with stale and error state plus manual refresh. Refresh polls every five seconds only while the page and window are visible, coalesces manual refresh with in-flight work, backs off to 10, 20, 40 then 60 seconds and resets after success, cancels work on hide, project switch, unload or disable, discards late results for an earlier selection, keeps last-good data visibly stale instead of replacing it with zeros, distinguishes an empty project from a failed read, scopes caches, links, cursors, filters and errors by project and runtime route, uses the content revision to avoid needless rerenders, and renders commit messages and agent content as escaped untrusted text. No mutation control, assignment, reply composer, card or background job is created. Implementation baseline: merged main 6276d5f / ledger closure e64d4bd, Waystation 0.6.0 on Bun 1.4.1; see docs/reconciliation-2026-09-27.md. Reuse the merged foundation and its tests. The existing desktop/plugin.js is only a no-op placeholder. Implement the native SDK source and build artifact here, consuming W08b data and registry settings without deriving worker routes from the selected tab. W08d owns manifests and final installation; agent discussion views read Waystation messages, while live Hermes transcripts remain optional W08e work.
acceptance: Every required view renders from the backend with the selected project explicit, wont_do is visually distinct from done, and a wont_do dependency renders as satisfied rather than blocking.
Refresh follows the visible-page rule with the documented backoff, and hiding, switching project, unloading or disabling stops work and cannot publish a late result.
A failed read keeps last-good data marked stale, an empty project is distinguishable from a failure, and content revisions prevent rerenders when only timestamps changed.
No write path, card creation, worker run or assignment exists in the surface, and a disabled plugin is reported accurately rather than as an empty board.
Record content is escaped and never executed as instructions.
notes:
The Monitor's selected project never controls worker routing, and presentation state is not canonical. Acceptance group A15 native half.

POC-first decision (2026-09-27): deferred behind task-poc-value-review. Keep this full-plan task todo. A completed review, including a negative/stop decision, does not authorize promotion; the owner must explicitly select an MVP scope. Before implementation, inspect POC artifacts and acceptance evidence and reuse or retire them rather than duplicating native UI, adapters or assembly. Full requirements remain preserved here.
